candidates.name: A · Quest Book Map
candidates.concept: The app is Zargon's own quest map, coming alive as the heroes explore.
candidates.typography: TeX Gyre Bonum Bold for titles, TeX Gyre Pagella for text
traits: Book page: title band, map left, notes column right
Unexplored = red-rock hatching like the printed maps
Green monster tokens, door callout like a margin note
Light screen: strong glare in a dim room

candidates.name: B · Lantern
candidates.concept: Only what the lantern touches exists.
candidates.typography: Instrument Serif for titles, Inter for interface text
traits: Full-bleed board, floating controls on the darkness
Unexplored is black with a faint memory of the room walls
Last revealed room carries a warm glow
Dark screen does not compete with the physical board

candidates.name: C · Field Slate
candidates.concept: A tactical plan readable from one meter; the fantasy lives on the table.
candidates.typography: TeX Gyre Heros Condensed for labels, Liberation Mono for codes and numbers
traits: Status strip on top, control column left, board right
Monsters as orange code tags O1, O2
